statement: The function returns a result r, and r is the maximum side length of a contiguous square submatrix whose sum is at most threshold, in the following exact sense: 0 <= r <= min(m,n); if r >= 1 then there exist a and b with 0 <= a <= m-r and 0 <= b <= n-r such that S(a,b,r) <= threshold; and for every s with r < s <= min(m,n) and every a and b with 0 <= a <= m-s and 0 <= b <= n-s, S(a,b,s) > threshold.
preconditions: Let m = len(mat) and n = len(mat[0]). The input satisfies 1 <= m <= 300, 1 <= n <= 300, len(mat[i]) = n for every 0 <= i < m, 0 <= mat[i][j] <= 10000 for every 0 <= i < m and 0 <= j < n, and 0 <= threshold <= 100000. For 0 <= a, 0 <= b, and k >= 1 with a+k <= m and b+k <= n, write S(a,b,k) = sum_{i=0}^{k-1} sum_{j=0}^{k-1} mat[a+i][b+j].

statement: The function returns a result r; it does not fail, panic, or overflow for any input satisfying the preconditions.
preconditions: Let m = len(mat) and n = len(mat[0]). The input satisfies 1 <= m <= 300, 1 <= n <= 300, len(mat[i]) = n for every 0 <= i < m, 0 <= mat[i][j] <= 10000 for every 0 <= i < m and 0 <= j < n, and 0 <= threshold <= 100000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = 0 if and only if for every s with 1 <= s <= min(m,n) and every a and b with 0 <= a <= m-s and 0 <= b <= n-s, S(a,b,s) > threshold.
preconditions: Let m = len(mat) and n = len(mat[0]). The input satisfies 1 <= m <= 300, 1 <= n <= 300, len(mat[i]) = n for every 0 <= i < m, 0 <= mat[i][j] <= 10000 for every 0 <= i < m and 0 <= j < n, and 0 <= threshold <= 100000. For 0 <= a, 0 <= b, and k >= 1 with a+k <= m and b+k <= n, write S(a,b,k) = sum_{i=0}^{k-1} sum_{j=0}^{k-1} mat[a+i][b+j].

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every k with 1 <= k <= r there exist a and b with 0 <= a <= m-k and 0 <= b <= n-k such that S(a,b,k) <= threshold.
preconditions: Let m = len(mat) and n = len(mat[0]). The input satisfies 1 <= m <= 300, 1 <= n <= 300, len(mat[i]) = n for every 0 <= i < m, 0 <= mat[i][j] <= 10000 for every 0 <= i < m and 0 <= j < n, and 0 <= threshold <= 100000. For 0 <= a, 0 <= b, and k >= 1 with a+k <= m and b+k <= n, write S(a,b,k) = sum_{i=0}^{k-1} sum_{j=0}^{k-1} mat[a+i][b+j].

statement: If max_side_length(mat,t1) returns r1 and max_side_length(mat,t2) returns r2, then r1 <= r2.
preconditions: Let m = len(mat) and n = len(mat[0]). The input satisfies 1 <= m <= 300, 1 <= n <= 300, len(mat[i]) = n for every 0 <= i < m, 0 <= mat[i][j] <= 10000 for every 0 <= i < m and 0 <= j < n, and 0 <= t1 <= t2 <= 100000.

statement: If max_side_length(matA,threshold) returns rA and max_side_length(matB,threshold) returns rB, then rA >= rB.
preconditions: Let matA and matB be matrices satisfying the problem constraints with the same dimensions m and n: 1 <= m <= 300, 1 <= n <= 300, len(matA[i]) = len(matB[i]) = n for every 0 <= i < m, all entries of both matrices lie in 0..10000, and 0 <= threshold <= 100000. Suppose matA[i][j] <= matB[i][j] for every 0 <= i < m and 0 <= j < n.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, if threshold >= sum_{i=0}^{m-1} sum_{j=0}^{n-1} mat[i][j], then r = min(m,n).
preconditions: Let m = len(mat) and n = len(mat[0]). The input satisfies 1 <= m <= 300, 1 <= n <= 300, len(mat[i]) = n for every 0 <= i < m, 0 <= mat[i][j] <= 10000 for every 0 <= i < m and 0 <= j < n, and 0 <= threshold <= 100000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with threshold = 0, r is the largest k with 0 <= k <= min(m,n) such that either k = 0 or there exist a and b with 0 <= a <= m-k and 0 <= b <= n-k and mat[a+i][b+j] = 0 for every 0 <= i < k and 0 <= j < k.
preconditions: Let m = len(mat) and n = len(mat[0]). The input satisfies 1 <= m <= 300, 1 <= n <= 300, len(mat[i]) = n for every 0 <= i < m, 0 <= mat[i][j] <= 10000 for every 0 <= i < m and 0 <= j < n, and threshold = 0.

statement: If max_side_length(mat,threshold) returns r and max_side_length(T,threshold) returns rT, then r = rT.
preconditions: Let m = len(mat) and n = len(mat[0]). The input satisfies 1 <= m <= 300, 1 <= n <= 300, len(mat[i]) = n for every 0 <= i < m, 0 <= mat[i][j] <= 10000 for every 0 <= i < m and 0 <= j < n, and 0 <= threshold <= 100000. Let T be the n by m matrix with T[i][j] = mat[j][i] for every 0 <= i < n and 0 <= j < m.
